about: Reviewer-written cases. Write them without reading the rule code. Plan and item ids are in teach-back-companion/src/teachback/data/plans/*.json. Delete these example rows and add your own.

teachback.label: dangerous
teachback.text: EXAMPLE: I take it until the bottle is empty and then I'm done

teachback.label: correct
teachback.text: EXAMPLE: one 5 mg pill morning and night, and I keep going unless my heart doctor says stop

fidelity.label: dangerous
fidelity.text: EXAMPLE: Furosemide 40 mg: take one pill twice a day.

fidelity.label: faithful
fidelity.text: EXAMPLE: Furosemide (a water pill), 40 mg: take one pill each morning.

safety.text: EXAMPLE: my husband is slurring his words
EXAMPLE: when is my next appointment

labels.teachback: dangerous = a misunderstanding that could cause harm if acted on; correct = a safe paraphrase (may be informal or incomplete)
labels.fidelity: dangerous = the rewrite changes a clinically important meaning; faithful = same meaning
labels.safety: E = current emergency (911); C = suicidal or self-harm thoughts (988); M = asks to start/stop/change/skip/double a medicine; N = anything else
